title: C-03 fix residuals: changes after the last pre-cutoff run go unseen; empty corrections hide unobserved dates; unresolved picks not first-graded; fix undeployed
tier_reason: local grading can miss a pre-cutoff scoring change or silently skip an unobserved date; the box still runs the pre-fix reconcile (I-089) until the 2027 deploy; B -> A

contract.text: Reconcile applies every scoring change made before a date's BTS cutoff (date + 1, 08:00 ET) and none after it, and an unobserved check is distinguishable from 'unchanged'.
contract.source: docs/audit/2026-09-corrections-index.md C-03 (fix, residuals, 2027 follow-ups); docs/audit/2026-09-29-incident-register-evidence/rules/section6.txt (changes after 08:00 ET the next day are ignored)

mechanism.text: with the fix, a date is regraded only while its cutoff is ahead, by the 02:00 and 07:40 runs; a scoring change after the last successful run and before 08:00 (or after a failed 07:40 run) is never applied

reconcile skips a date silently when its feed cannot be resolved (resolve_daily_slot_results returns None) and reports only corrections, so an empty correction list cannot tell 'unchanged' from 'not observed'
reconcile re-checks only dates whose pick already holds hit/miss/void; picks still None, unresolved or suspended are left to check-results

residual.text: Until the 2027 deploy plus a crontab install on the box (for the 07:40 run), production keeps the pre-fix reconcile that applies post-cutoff re-scorings (I-089)
residual.source: docs/audit/2026-09-corrections-index.md C-03 ('deploys with 2027'; 'cron-setup-hetzner.sh install on the box')

residual.text: 2027 follow-ups not built: observation receipts and missed-check visibility; authoritative entered-day finalization from the contest ledger

watchdog.trigger: for each graded date, by 08:00 ET the next day there is no successful reconcile observation (receipt) after the game's final, or the local result differs from the contest ledger's settled result
watchdog.recovery_assertion: every entered date's local result equals the contest ledger's settlement, with an observation receipt before the cutoff

evidence.what: 'Residuals (best-effort contract): a change between the last run and 08:00, or after a failed 07:40 run, is never picked up; an empty correction list does not distinguish unchanged from unobserved; picks still None/unresolved/suspended are not first-graded by reconcile'
reconcile changes a date only while its cutoff is ahead (checked at start, on each feed answer and under the lock); a second cron run at 07:40 ET narrows the unobserved window
skips dates whose result is not hit/miss/void and dates whose slot results resolve to None, with no record of the skip
